attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow is valid. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_ft_008
steps:
  - id: receive_measurement
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: trigger.payload
      fields:
        - user_id
        - weight_kg
        - measured_date
        - measured_time
    output: measurement_data

  - id: validate_schema
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: "{{measurement_data}}"
      schema:
        required:
          - user_id
          - weight_kg
          - measured_date
        properties:
          user_id:
            type: string
          weight_kg:
            type: number
          measured_date:
            type: string
            format: date
          measured_time:
            type: string
    output: schema_result

  - id: handle_schema_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      condition: "{{schema_result.valid}} == false"
      action: terminate
      message: "Invalid measurement payload: missing or malformed fields."

  - id: validate_plausible_range
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: "{{measurement_data.weight_kg}}"
      rule: "value >= 30 AND value <= 300"
    output: range_check

  - id: reject_implausible
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      condition: "{{range_check.passed}} == false"
      reason: "Weight measurement {{measurement_data.weight_kg}} kg is outside plausible range (30-300 kg)."

  - id: check_existing_today
    op: read_database
    params:
      collection: weight_measurements
      filter:
        user_id: "{{measurement_data.user_id}}"
        measured_date: "{{measurement_data.measured_date}}"
    output: existing_records

  - id: warn_duplicate_day
    op: notify_user
    params:
      condition: "{{existing_records.count}} > 0"
      user_id: "{{measurement_data.user_id}}"
      channel: in_app
      message: "You already have a weight entry for today. This new measurement will be stored alongside it. Only one measurement per day is recommended."

  - id: store_measurement
    op: write_database
    params:
      collection: weight_measurements
      document:
        user_id: "{{measurement_data.user_id}}"
        weight_kg: "{{measurement_data.weight_kg}}"
        measured_date: "{{measurement_data.measured_date}}"
        measured_time: "{{measurement_data.measured_time}}"
        created_at: "{{now()}}"
    output: stored_record

  - id: log_audit
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: weight_measurement_logged
      user_id: "{{measurement_data.user_id}}"
      details:
        weight_kg: "{{measurement_data.weight_kg}}"
        measured_date: "{{measurement_data.measured_date}}"
        record_id: "{{stored_record.id}}"
